heading: Is Egg-bread gluten free?
intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Egg-bread and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Egg-bread may contain gluten if made with traditional bread ingredients, such as wheat flour. Cross-contamination is also a concern if prepared in a shared kitchen environment.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
